title: AI Strategy & Portfolio
subtitle: Turn business strategy into a value-ranked AI portfolio
summary: Build an enterprise AI strategy, find high-value use cases, sequence bets, and distinguish transformative initiatives from automation theater.

lessons.title: Strategy before tooling
lessons.body: Start from company strategy: revenue growth, margin, customer experience, speed, risk, and strategic differentiation. AI initiatives should map directly to measurable enterprise objectives.

lessons.title: Use-case discovery
lessons.body: Use process mapping and value-stream analysis to identify opportunities in decision support, content, software development, operations, customer service, knowledge work, forecasting, and autonomous workflows.

lessons.title: Portfolio scoring
lessons.body: Score use cases on strategic value, financial value, feasibility, data readiness, adoption difficulty, risk, time-to-value, and option value. Avoid a single ROI metric that hides strategic importance or risk.

objectives: Tie AI work to enterprise KPIs

quiz.q: The best starting point for enterprise AI strategy is:
options: The company strategy and value pools
A mandate to use GenAI everywhere
A mix of near-term value and longer-horizon strategic bets
Only projects with immediate hard-dollar savings

homework: Build a 12-use-case AI portfolio for a hypothetical company. Rank it using a transparent scoring model and select 3 lighthouse use cases, 5 scale candidates, and 4 experiments.

visual.title: Illustrative investment path
visual.note: At each step, evidence determines whether funding grows.
